## Tips & gotchas

- Xterra and Frontier typically use 1330 slip yokes. [t525]
- [Partial] Pathfinders generally utilize 1350 joints. [t525]
- Early Titans (approx. 2004-2007) used 1350s, while later models shifted to 1410. [t525]

## Common mistakes

- Assuming all yokes are standard cut; Nissan requires involute splines on the pinion. [t525]
- [Partial] Confusing the width of a 1330 vs 1350, as they share similar widths but differ in cap size affecting operational angle. [t525]
